behavior_constraints: Adds a `report --store-dir <dir>` subcommand to the CLI.
When the store has no results, prints exactly `No results found.` and exits 0.
For non-empty stores, prints the header line exactly: `=== NumeriForge Reproducibility Report ===`.
Groups stored results by unique experiment name and prints each name with its result count and earliest-to-latest timestamp date range.
Prints an environment summary listing unique OS + arch combinations found across all results.
Prints an integrity summary that verifies each stored result and reports counts of OK, FAIL, and NO_CHECKSUM results.
Prints the final line exactly: `Report complete: <total> results across <N> experiments`, where total is all results and N is the number of unique experiments.
Exits 0 after generating a successful report.
All existing commands and functionality continue to work unchanged.
entities.summary: This round adds a `report` command that summarizes stored experiment results, environments, and integrity status.
